_about: What the reviewed rename apply would write for plan slash-to-and-2026-11-18, measured by the S679 worker from the committed files and a local run of kb/_cred_rename_dryrun.py --only-plan slash-to-and-2026-11-18 on origin/main 82a3dad7 merged into the branch, 2026-11-18. Rebuilt after the S679 conductor's rulings on COBIx's review (#3479, comment 6966714099): a spaced slash between two whole names is held for a person, "Medical/Surgical" keeps its slash as an official phrase, and the combine check compares case-folded, whitespace-squashed titles against every credential and search alias. Per-title counts are the earlier preview's, measured on the same files. A preview, not a receipt: no apply has run. The apply writes its own receipt, kb/cred_rename_out/<date>/ (undo.json, supabase_log), and kb/_cred_rename_undo.py reverses it.
